text.arabic_uthmani: مَّا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ

words.gloss_range: negative particle opening a negation-exception restriction, later echoed by relative uses of the same surface particle
words.prose: {{ar:مَّا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens by denying the whole burden frame before the exception restores one surviving duty. Its payoff is structural as well as semantic: the ayah first empties the messenger's obligation field, then lets only delivery remain. The later relative instances of the same particle form turn that opening exclusion into a local echo, moving from what is not upon the messenger to whatever the audience discloses or conceals.

topics.headline: opening negation creates exclusive restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by denying every messenger-burden before naming the one duty that survives.
topics.reason: The particle is licensed as negation in the first clause and works with the exception particle to produce restriction rather than ordinary negation.

topics.headline: same particle form moves from exclusion to open reference
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one small repeated form first excludes extra duties and later opens the total field of disclosed and concealed acts.
topics.reason: The first occurrence is negative while the later two are relative pronouns, so the CRITICAL reparse claim survives as a local form-function shift.

topics.headline: first word creates suspense before the remaining duty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's first visible unit withholds the positive duty until the restriction has already been felt.
topics.reason: The particle is the ayah's first word and precedes both the messenger phrase and the exception landing.

words.gloss_range: preposition of incumbency, retaining the concrete image of a weight placed upon the messenger
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) casts the issue as something resting upon the messenger, not merely something associated with him or authority he exercises over others. The preposition keeps a concrete burden-image inside the legal obligation sense: weights are removed from the messenger, with only the delivery left. Because the phrase stands inside the restriction frame and before the duty is named, the reader first sees the bearer and burden-frame before the content of the duty appears.

topics.headline: obligation imagined as weight upon the messenger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger's role is framed as a removable burden, so the clause lightens every weight except delivery.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both identify the preposition as governing the messenger phrase in an obligation predicate.

topics.headline: fronted burden phrase delays the duty's content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah foregrounds the messenger as duty-bearer before revealing the sole remaining duty.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is the fronted predicate under the restriction construction, so the CRITICAL fronting and enclosure claims are locally licensed.

topics.headline: uponness selects burden rather than mastery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the spatial force of uponness while the local grammar selects duty resting on the messenger, not the messenger's authority over others.
topics.reason: The broader prepositional range is real, but local syntax and the negation-exception frame narrow it to incumbency.

words.gloss_range: the known sent messenger as governed duty-bearer, not the clausal subject or outcome-controller
words.root_gloss_range: sending, dispatch, release, and messenger office; local noun sense selects the sent role inside the delivery-limit clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition governing the messenger as duty-bearer

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّسُولِ}} ({{tr:ar-rasūli}}) is governed by {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), so the messenger is the one upon whom a duty would rest, not the nominative subject of the clause. The definite singular role noun compresses a known office rather than narrating a fresh sending event. The root-field of sending makes the title a transmission office: the sent one is confined to delivery, not control over response, with a softer release-color around the role while the recited article fuses into the title. Same-surah echoes sharpen the formula, with messenger-delivery language at 5:92 and the conveyance command at 5:67 becoming here a declarative role-limit.

topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the preposition and enclosed within the negation-exception construction.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: sole delivery duty admitted by the exception

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge where denial becomes a single surviving affirmation. It excludes every other burden and admits only {{ar:ٱلْبَلَٰغُ}} ({{tr:al-balāghu}}), so the first clause is not a vague minimization of the messenger's role but a sharp role-boundary. Its separate particle form makes the turn visible between the negated messenger-burden and the delivery noun, while the opening negator and this exception particle brace the messenger phrase as paired function words.

words.gloss_range: the definite delivery or conveyance that reaches its addressee and alone remains as the messenger's duty
words.root_gloss_range: reaching, arriving, attaining completion or maturity, and sufficient notification; local noun selects delivery as the bounded role-duty
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَلَٰغُ}} ({{tr:al-balāghu}}) names the one burden admitted by the exception. Its definiteness and delayed nominative position make the recognized delivery duty the landing point of the first clause. The root's reaching and sufficiency pressure keeps this from sounding like bare speech-output: the duty is conveyed delivery that reaches its addressee, while acceptance and hidden response fall outside the messenger's burden. Completion and target-arrival color the noun without turning it into guaranteed audience acceptance, and the long ā with the final ghayn gives the delayed landing audible weight. Within Surah 5, the command at 5:67 and the clear-delivery formula at 5:92 are distilled here into the bare role-limit.

topics.headline: definite delivery is the sole exception

topics.reason: The word is definite, nominative, delayed as the subject, and governed by the exception relation.

topics.headline: delivery carries reaching and sufficiency pressure

topics.reason: The local noun belongs to the reaching-delivery field, and nothing in the guardrails contradicts the sufficiency/reaching payoff.

topics.reason: The referenced formula rows are concrete and reinforce the local exception construction.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening a new divine-knowledge clause after the messenger-duty limit
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not add another item to the messenger's duty; it resumes with a new clause. The pivot moves from human limitation to divine knowledge while keeping the two halves tightly adjacent. Because the connector attaches directly into the divine-name opening, the transition is compact and immediate, not mediated by a heavier discourse marker. That small connector is therefore the hinge between the messenger's completed delivery burden and Allah's knowing of what the audience reveals and conceals.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is explicitly fronted before {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}), even though the verb could carry a subject morphologically. The second half therefore begins by naming the knower, not by continuing with an implied pronoun. This makes the contrast crisp: the messenger's duty is limited, while Allah is the named subject whose knowledge covers what people disclose and conceal. The proper name carries worship and awe pressure around the knower, and its doubled lām gives the pivot audible weight before the verb. The boundary from 5:98 also reverses direction: people were commanded to know divine attributes, and now Allah knows them.

words.gloss_range: ongoing divine knowing governing both open relative object domains
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, recognition, and awareness opposed to ignorance; local verb selects ongoing knowing, not teaching, learning, or comparison
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}) is an imperfect predicate of ongoing divine knowledge. It governs two open object domains, what the audience discloses and what they conceal, making the exterior and interior poles one field under Allah's knowing and removing any imagined ignorance advantage in concealment. The local Form I verb selects direct knowing rather than teaching, learning, or comparative knowing, so the epistemic ground of accountability stays precise. The compact knowledge predicate stands before the two longer human-action verbs, and it carries the boundary reversal from 5:98: the audience commanded to know is now known. The recurring formula at 2:33 and 24:29 supports the total-awareness force here without changing the local syntax.

words.prose: {{ar:تُبْدُونَ}} ({{tr:tubdūna}}) makes the audience active agents of disclosure. Its Form IV causative shape is not passive visibility; it is causing something to come into view, gathered by the preceding open relative particle, with an exposed open-field image behind the act of making-visible. Paired with {{ar:تَكْتُمُونَ}} ({{tr:taktumūna}}), it forms the visible pole of a reveal-conceal merism under Allah's knowledge, and the shared second-person plural ending audibly binds both opposite actions to the same addressed group. The formula also recurs at 2:33 and 24:29, while 5:101 supplies a nearby disclosure warning in a different passive frame.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive construction around الرسول and البلاغ isolates a carried message as the messenger's assigned burden.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger is a carrier of speech, while البلاغ combines conveying with arrival at a communicative limit; the construction bounds responsibility without reducing the task to mere noise.

activation_trace.role: Carries the literal messenger-and-message sense and anchors the office as carriage of speech.
Supplies literal message-conveyance and makes transmission the office's explicit content.
Adds reaching an endpoint, so the functional image is completed arrival rather than bare emission.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is simply excused from responsibility for belief.
changed_reading.after: The messenger bears a positive but bounded commission: carry the message to its communicative endpoint, without owning the addressee's response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يعلم, تبدون, and تكتمون form an explicit knowledge-manifestation-concealment triad after the messenger clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Manifesting brings something out after concealment, while concealing holds it from announcement; divine knowing spans both states and therefore reaches the recipient-side response that messengerly delivery cannot control.

activation_trace.role: Supplies direct cognitive disclosure and assigns comprehensive awareness to God.
Supplies emergence from hiding and functions as the observable side of response.
Supplies withholding from announcement and functions as the unobservable side of response.

changed_reading.before: The second clause merely adds a general warning that God is omniscient.
changed_reading.after: The verse reallocates roles: the messenger performs outward communication, while God audits both the response that surfaces and the response held back.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun البلاغ can carry the branch of sufficiency or provision in addition to conveyance.
baseline_models.mechanism: On this focus-only branch, the messenger hands over a communicative sufficiency: enough by which the addressee can proceed, not an exhaustive transfer of everything God knows.

activation_trace.role: Supplies literal sufficiency or journey-provision and models the message as an adequate entrusted portion.
Keeps exhaustive knowledge with God, against which the delivered sufficiency remains bounded.

changed_reading.before: بلاغ names only the act of transmitting information.
changed_reading.after: بلاغ may also name the sufficient communicative provision entrusted to recipients, sharply distinguished from God's exhaustive knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier near-duplicate joins obedience, possible turning-away, and clear conveyance. Clarity therefore qualifies the messenger's output, while the explicit possibility of refusal keeps compliance outside his control.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clear conveyance alongside recipient refusal; I infer that clarity is required but coercive success is not. A live alternative is that the formula only consoles the messenger after refusal rather than defining a general office.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accessible temptation, testing, divine knowing, and fear in the unseen; I infer that action externalizes a latent response. The alternative is that the knowing formula marks judicial manifestation rather than any acquisition or disclosure of knowledge.

changed_reading.before: What people show or conceal chiefly sounds like statements or consciously reported secrets.
changed_reading.after: What is disclosed includes conduct elicited by a test, while what is concealed includes the allegiance or fear from which that conduct proceeds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root describes a designated offering physically reaching a named destination. That material transit activates the endpoint branch inside البلاغ: communication is a handoff that must arrive, not merely leave the sender.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material item and named destination; I transfer the arrival relation to communicative delivery. The live alternative is that message-delivery requires reaching an audience but not verified comprehension.

changed_reading.after: بلاغ carries a destination-sensitive demand: the entrusted message must reach its addressee, though acceptance remains outside the messenger's burden.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questions can press concealed matters into disclosure, yet the packet says some disclosure would cause harm and ties its appearance to revelatory timing. The messenger's duty is therefore authorized conveyance, not forced total transparency of everything God knows.

structural_cues: 5:101 forbids probing questions whose answers would distress, while allowing disclosure when the recitation is being sent down.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harmful disclosure and revelatory timing; I infer an authorization boundary between entrusted message and exhaustive exposure. The live alternative is a narrow rule about burdensome questions rather than a general communication principle.

changed_reading.before: The public/hidden contrast implies that disclosure is always preferable and messengerly delivery should expose everything.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowledge is total, but messengerly disclosure is commissioned and timed; concealment is not automatically blameworthy, while unauthorized demands for exposure can be harmful.

context_deltas.mechanism: The testimony procedure gives concealment a social and evidentiary mechanism: a witness can hold known evidence back, while counter-testimony and discovery expose what was suppressed. Divine knowing exceeds, but does not erase, human procedures for making truth public.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testimony, explicit concealment, later discovery, and replacement witnesses; I infer a disclosure pipeline that repairs suppressed evidence. A live alternative is that 5:99 concerns all private states while this sequence only supplies one concrete subtype.

changed_reading.after: تكتمون also includes socially consequential evidence deliberately withheld from public judgment, with God knowing beyond the reach and repairs of procedure.

Messengers can account for what they conveyed and witnessed, but they do not possess the hidden response or control later attribution; those remain under divine knowledge and watch.

structural_cues: 5:109 asks the gathered messengers how they were answered; they disclaim knowledge and assign unseen knowledge to God.
5:111 identifies Jesus as God's messenger before 5:116 tests an attribution of unauthorized speech.
5:117 confines Jesus's speech to command, his witness to his presence, and post-taking watch to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies messenger succession, denied knowledge of reception, authorized speech, bounded presence, and transferred watch; I infer a temporal and epistemic custody boundary around delivery. Alternatives remain live: the denial in 5:109 may be judgment-scene rhetoric, and 5:117 may describe Jesus specifically rather than every messenger.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a generic division of labor between a preacher and an omniscient God.
changed_reading.after: The focus defines a chain of custody: the messenger owns authorized delivery and witnessed presence, while God owns hidden reception, audit, and transformations that occur after messengerly presence ends.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's form-distant ب د د split for تبدون, so it must not replace the ordinary ظهور sense. It remains anchored because the split inventory is explicit and the testimony sequence supplies real allocation and withholding of information; downstream prose should label it an exploratory information-control analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The non-dominant ب د د mapping for تبدون offers dispersal or exclusive possession beside تكتمون's withholding.

changed_reading.before: Showing and concealing are static states of publicity and privacy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pair also tracks control over information: what actors release into shared judgment versus what they retain as exclusive possession.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The table is a material-food scene, so mapping it onto communication is deliberately cross-domain. The البلاغ sufficiency branch, followed by provision sought for reassurance, knowledge, and testimony, keeps the analogy anchored; downstream prose should present it as a possible functional image, not a lexical equation of message and food.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: البلاغ carries a branch of sufficient provision, bounded against God's exhaustive knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Supplies literal sufficiency or provision and anchors the message as an adequate portion for proceeding.

Supplies resulting knowledge while preserving the distinction between recipient assurance and God's exhaustive knowing.
Supplies verified truthful speech and links provision to confirmation of the messenger's saying.

changed_reading.before: The message is an abstract packet of information that either gets transmitted or not.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the message is a sufficient provision handed over for reassurance, recognition of truth, and testimony, without making the messenger responsible for consuming it on the recipients' behalf.

strongest_changes: 5:95 turns البلاغ from outgoing speech into completed arrival at a specified destination.
5:101 and 5:106-108 distinguish authorized disclosure from harmful forced exposure and sharpen concealment into suppressed evidence.
5:109 and 5:116-117 make the role division epistemic and temporal: messengers convey and witness, while God owns hidden reception and later history.
summary.what_was_special: Across the four-pericope packet, the focus roots recur in material, procedural, and judgment scenes: arrival, testing, questioning, testimony, messenger audit, inward knowledge, and transferred watch produce changed readings rather than a shared broad theme.
remaining_uncertainties: The material arrival in 5:95 securely requires reaching a destination, but it does not decide whether communicative arrival includes verified comprehension.
The custody boundary in 5:116-117 may generalize from Jesus to messengerly office, or it may remain specific to that judgment scene.
The ب د د information-allocation and البلاغ-as-provision readings remain deliberately contained analogies.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Conveyance reaches the public boundary; knowledge crosses it.** `ب ل غ B001` is reaching a limit, `ب د و B001` visible emergence, and `ك ت م B001` concealment. The messenger's role ends at clear delivery; divine knowledge spans what emerges and what stays covered. I infer a clean allocation of responsibility between public communication and inward judgment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Public delivery ends where concealed reception begins.** Fixed **ب ل غ / B002** (“conveying a message”) defines the messenger’s task, while the fixed disclosure/concealment antithesis places both visible and hidden response under divine knowledge. 5:98 delivered the paired warning and mercy; 5:100 asks for discrimination despite impressive abundance, and 5:101 warns about forced disclosure. I infer a jurisdictional handoff: the messenger makes the norm reach, but cannot manufacture the receiver’s interior. The ayah reads as a boundary between communicative completion and accountable reception.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:101 made the boundary unexpectedly active: asking can force concealed matters into visibility, so reception includes responsibility for what one demands to be disclosed.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı dal içinde iki açık gönderim öğesi verir: gönderenin sözünü taşıyan kişi ve taşınan söz ya da haber. Çerçeve bu düzenli kişi-içerik ayrımını doğru biçimde korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda haber taşıyan kişi ile taşınan içeriği birlikte gösterir; özel kalıplardaki eşsesli anlamlar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir gönderenin sözünü veya haberini başka birine götüren kişi ya da bu kişinin taşıdığı söz, haber ve iletidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, bir gönderenden bir alıcıya içerik taşıyan ileti bağını kurar.
Kişi okumasında, taşıyıcı gönderen adına haberleri izleyen ve aktaran görevlidir.
İçerik okumasında sözcük, taşıyıcının götürdüğü sözün veya haberin kendisini belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, gönderici ile alıcı arasındaki aktarımı hem taşıyıcı kişi hem de taşınan söz bakımından kurar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kimsenin bir seyle tek basina kalmasi veya onu kendine ayirmasi anlamini verir. Bu, paylari dagitmak degil, paylasimi dislayarak bir seyi yalniz kendi tasarrufuna alma anlamidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation oldugu icin tanim kisi ve sey iliskisindeki tek basina sahiplenme kalibina baglidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin bir seyi baskalariyla paylasmayip tek basina kendine ayirmasi veya onunla yalniz kalmasi.

facets.statement: Bir seyle tek basina kalma ve baskalarini ortakliktan dislama cekirdek anlamdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı kanit, dalı bir kisinin belli bir seyi tek basina kendine ayirmasi olarak verir; paylastirma veya teslim etme anlamlari bu dalda yoktur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kisinin bir seyi ortaklardan ayirip yalniz kendine tutmasi anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tek basinalik, sahiplenme ve paylasmama kosullarini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir seyi baskalarindan ayirip kendi payina veya tasarrufuna alma baglaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kendine ozgu kilma ve tek basina alma anlamini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir seyi tek basina kendine ayirmak

error_profile.preserves: Bir seyin kisilerle iliskisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek basina sahiplenme ve ortaklari dislama anlamini kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kalipli olarak bir seyle tek basina kalmayi soyler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal baskalarina tercih ederek kendine alma ve bencilce ayirma alanini daha genis tasir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de bir seyi baskalariyla paylasmayip kendine ozgu kilmayi anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: B008 tek basina ayrilma kalibina daralir; komşu dal genel oz sahiplenme ve tercihli alma alanindadir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Burada bir kimsenin bir seyi fiilen tek basina tutmasi vurgulanir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal has, ozel ve ortakliktan ayrilmis olma niteliklerini daha genis kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de ortakliktan ayrilmislik ve ozel olma alanindadir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: B008 eylemli sahiplenmedir; komşu dal nitelik ve aitlik alaninda daha genistir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tek basina alma, sahiplenme, teslim etme, guc ve ayni root dallari karsilastirildi; paylastirma karsitligi ozellikle belirgindir.

root_profile.summary: Bu rootte anlamlar ayirma ve ayrilma ekseninden paylastirma, bire bir eslestirme, ayrilmazlik, aralik, tek basina sahiplenme, guc, beden iriligi ve bedel gibi farkli dallara acilir. Dallar birbirine yuzeysel olarak yakin gorunse de her biri belirli bir iliskiyi korur: daginiklik, hisse, rakip, satis karsiligi, zorunluluk, fiziksel aralik, el hareketi, sahiplenme, takat, irilik veya bedel.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ya da sözü görünür ve açık olmaktan alıkoyma çekirdeğini doğrudan destekler. Haber, sır, tanıklık, hak ve iyilik gibi farklı nesneler bu genel saklama eyleminin kapsamına girebilir; ancak ses, su ya da solukla ilgili öteki dallar bu tanımın parçası değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel saklama çekirdeğini verir; türemiş biçimler ile sır, kişi ve iyilik nesneli kalıplaşmış kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleri olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi, sözü ya da bilgiyi başkalarınca bilinmeyecek veya açıkça görülmeyecek biçimde saklamak ve açıklamaktan alıkoymaktır.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyin veya bilginin açıklanmasını engelleyerek onu gizli tutmaktır.
Saklanan içerik söz, sır, tanıklık, hak ya da görülmüş bir iyilik olabilir; nesne değişse de açıklamama işlemi değişmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarımlar, temel anlamı bir şeyi veya sözü gizli tutmak ve açıklamanın karşıtı olarak sunmakta birleşir. Farklı nesneler bu ortak çekirdeğin kapsam örnekleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin veya bilginin bilinmesini ya da açıkça ortaya konmasını isteyerek engelleyen genel eylemi karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gizli tutma işlemini hem de açıklamama sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Saklanan içeriğin bir sır olduğu doğal anlatım bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sırrın başkalarına açıklanmadan gizli tutulmasını eksiksiz biçimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir hak, tanıklık veya gerçek bilginin bilerek açıklanmadığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilinen bir içeriği görünür ve bilinir olmaktan alıkoyma işlemini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bir şeyi veya bilgiyi açıklamama yönündeki etkin tutumu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir şeyin kendiliğinden gizli veya görünmez durumda bulunmasını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir şeyin açıkça görünür veya bilinir olmaması vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği, içeriği açıklamayıp saklamaktır; komşu dal ise eylemin yanı sıra genel gizlilik ve görünmezlik durumunu da kapsadığı için tam eş anlamlı değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, sır dışındaki sözleri, bilgileri ve şeyleri de açıklamadan saklayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle sır veya öğüdün içte tutulmasına bağlanmıştır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bilinen bir içeriğin başkasına aktarılmamasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Sır söz konusu olduğunda kullanımlar yaklaşır; ancak odak dalın nesne alanı daha geniş, komşu dalın alanı sır ve öğütle daha sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalın temel amacı içeriğin açığa çıkmasını engellemektir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, sahip olunan bir şeyi vermeme ve cimrilik etme tutumunu da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da elde bulunan bir şeyin başkasına ulaşmasının engellenmesi görülebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bilgi veya şeyi gizli tutar; komşu dal ise paylaşmama ve cimrilik eksenindedir. Bu yüzden ortak bir alıkoyma görüntüsü olsa da olağan ikame mümkün değildir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; en yararlı sınırlar genel gizlilik, sır saklama ve cimrice esirgeme ile kuruldu. Öteki adaylar karşıt açıklama eylemleri, uzak temalar veya bu kökün ayrı dalları olduğundan yayımlanmadı.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما وصف بأنه لا يصوت: الناقة أو الجمل لا يرغو، والسحاب لا رعد فيه، والقوس على قول من جعل الكاتم من القسي التي لا ترن.
يدخل فيه وصف القوس بأنها كتوم أو كتيم إذا لم يكن فيها شق أو صدع في نبعها ولا تنشق.
يدخل فيه الخرز أو السقاء أو المزادة إذا لم يخرج منها الماء أو ذهب سيلان الماء من مخارزها أول ما تشرب.
يدخل فيه الكتم: نبات أو شجر يخلط بالوسمة أو الحناء ويختضب به، وفيه حمرة أو سواد بحسب النقل.
يدخل فيه قولهم للفرس أو الدابة إذا ضاق منخره عن نفسه حتى يكتم الربو.

root_profile.summary: Kökün merkezinde bir şeyi açıklanmaktan, ses vermekten, sızmaktan veya akmaktan alıkoyma görüntüsü bulunur; bu görüntü bilgi saklama, belirli sessiz varlıklar, sağlam yay, sızdırmaz kap ve daralan soluk çıkışı olarak ayrı dallara açılır. Boya bitkisi adı ise bu örgü içinde bağımsız bir ad dalı oluşturur.
